dict.string: No Donuts checks the camera on-device to confirm you're at your Mac and locks it when you step away. Images never leave your device.
No Donuts reads your Wi-Fi router’s hardware address to confirm a trusted network is really yours (not a look-alike hotspot). Nothing is sent over the network.
No Donuts checks your current Wi-Fi network name to skip locking on networks you've marked as trusted (like home). This never leaves your device.
